infrastructure_retry.same_cell_constraint: Every rerun must have the identical manifest hash, ArbiterKB commit and clean state, pinned source commits, params hash, prompt hash, task, episode, split, arm, observation config, model, effort, resolved episode seed/difficulty and factorial inputs; enforced by retry_identity.
retryable_only: API failure after the MEMI client exhausts its own retries
never_retry: policy failure or invalid policy answer
infrastructure_retry.exhaustion: After the initial attempt and two identical reruns still fail, write the pair-drop record and exclude that (task, episode) from all nine arms, including any already completed arm rows.

validation_analysis_plan.purpose: Preregistered held-out confirmation; read test 0-49 once after this manifest is reviewed, frozen and recorded in the ledger
validation_analysis_plan.cell_formula: 5 tasks x 50 test episodes x 9 arms
validation_analysis_plan.secondary: P2a-P2c intervals only; at n=250 and G1 d=0.52 the detectable difference is about 16.5 pp; do not claim H2 equivalence
validation_analysis_plan.split_fidelity_caveat: Report MM-m minus stock MEMI and carry the preregistered caveat if the absolute difference exceeds 10 pp
provenance_required: manifest sha256 and freeze ledger record
model requested and every returned model id
effort, transport, retry policy and token prices
task, split, episode, resolved seed, difficulty and reset digest
per-call status, token usage including cached tokens, latency and client retry count
terminal status/reason/phase, watchdog limits, failed attempts and pair-drop records
execution host and the final host-specific invocation flags selected before freeze
validation_analysis_plan.environment_selection: pod, decided by the user 2026-11-02 for speed; see execution_host and execution_image
